entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse HR monitor. I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number? And just so I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
The name is Sam Jones, order number is VF78901. I'd call it a technical fault. The heart rate monitor is wildly inaccurate. Honestly, the product is kind of garbage.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the accuracy. I can definitely help with that. We can start with some basic troubleshooting steps, or I can transfer you directly to our technical support team who are experts with the new Pulse model.
I appreciate that, but I'm not really interested in a back-and-forth. I'm a busy person and I just don't have time to try and fix it. I'd prefer a simple refund.

I understand not wanting to spend more time on a frustrating issue. A transfer would be quick, but if you're set on a return, I need to check the policy for your order. Can you confirm the date you received the VeloBand?
Let's see... it was a Christmas gift, so it arrived around December 15th. I've tried it a few times and it's just not working for me. I don't want a replacement, I just want money back.

Okay, so you've had it for about 20 days. Let me just pull up our current return guidelines for you... one moment. [typing sounds] Okay, I'm looking at our knowledge base here. It says that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. So a return shouldn't be a problem then.

That's correct. Since you're well within the 90-day window, I can go ahead and process that return for you right now. I've just initiated it. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office.
That's perfect. That was much easier than I expected. Thank you for your help, Diana.

You're very welcome, Sam. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed back to the original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
